subject.title: fix(browser): tab creation steals window focus during agent automation

question: Should the extension relay intentionally treat an omitted Target.createTarget background value as background creation, despite upstream CDP defining that omitted case as foreground?
rationale: The change fixes disruptive agent behavior and preserves every explicit focus combination, but the omitted case is still an observable protocol-default change that source inspection and CI cannot authorize on behalf of existing relay clients.

options.title: Accept the automation default
options.body: Approve background-by-default for omitted relay requests because OpenClaw owns the automation endpoint, while keeping explicit foreground and focus semantics covered by tests.

options.title: Preserve generic CDP defaults
options.body: Keep omitted requests foreground-compatible and add an OpenClaw-specific session or creation signal for internal Playwright and agent page creation.

recommendation.title: Accept the automation default
recommendation.body: Approve background-by-default for omitted relay requests because OpenClaw owns the automation endpoint, while keeping explicit foreground and focus semantics covered by tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged browser-focus work makes steipete the strongest available owner for accepting or rejecting the relay compatibility tradeoff.
